description: From the AS-87 cycle-1 review (qa-priya, 2026-09-11, N3). apps/chat/test/loop-label.test.js:178 ('every build reason has prose') pins the reason list at 13 entries, but apps/chat/lib/loop-status.js:60 has 14 — AS-84's 'error' reason (evaluate() try/catch persisting {reason:'error'}) is not in the pin, so the guard examines 13 of 14 reasons and the missing one has no prose check. FIX: extend the pin 13 -> 14 (and derive cardinality from BUILD_REASONS or assert the count so a 15th reason cannot slip past). FALSIFIER: delete the 'error' prose entry and observe the test red. May instead be folded into AS-88's docs pass (planned, Lena) — whoever gets there first closes the other.
title: Chat: loop-label reason-list pin omits AS-84's 'error' build reason — 'every build reason has prose' examines 13 of 14
